sources.quote: External dimensions Approx. 295×55×327 mm (width × height × length) (excludes largest projection)
Input/ Output Super-Speed USB (USB 3.1 Gen.1) port × 3 AUX port × 1 Networking Ethernet (10BASE-T, 100BASE-TX, 1000BASE-T)×1
AV output HDMI™ out port (supports 4K/HDR) DIGITAL OUT (OPTICAL) port
Product name PlayStation®4 Pro Product code CUH-7000 series

notes: playstation.com/en-au PS4 tech-specs page, CUH-7000 series. Sony labels the third axis 'length' (width × height × length); it is recorded as depth, the front-to-back axis of a console standing on its feet. Excludes the largest projection.

ports = the page's Input/Output, Networking and AV output rows. Sony's table says 'USB' without naming the receptacle; it is filed as usb_a, the only USB receptacle in the §3 vocabulary before USB-C, and the reader should treat the A as Sony-unstated. The AUX port has no §3 kind. Power 'AC 100-240V' (internal); inlet not named, no power_in item.
released: not on the page; null. media uncovered. external_ids: Wikidata Q26906780 ('upgraded version of the PlayStation 4').
